# Munsell renotation data

`IwashiScopePackage/Sources/IwashiScopeFeature/Resources/MunsellRenotationAll.csv`
is generated from the “All Munsell Colours” dataset in Colour 0.4.7.

- Source: <https://github.com/colour-science/colour/blob/v0.4.7/colour/notation/datasets/munsell/all.py>
- Upstream data source: Munsell Color Science Laboratory, Rochester Institute of Technology
- Coordinate system: CIE 1931 2° observer and Illuminant C
- License: BSD 3-Clause (`LICENSES/Colour-BSD-3-Clause.txt`)
- Generator: `Scripts/generate-munsell-renotation-resource.py`

The generator verifies the pinned upstream SHA-256 and the expected 4,995 rows.
The source dataset stores luminance relative to a magnesium-oxide reference. At
runtime IwashiScope applies the documented factor 0.975 before converting it to
a perfect-reflecting-diffuser scale.

`IwashiScopePackage/Sources/IwashiScopeFeature/Resources/MunsellColorimetryCIE1931.csv`
is generated by `Scripts/generate-munsell-colorimetry-resource.py` from the
Illuminant C spectrum and CIE 1931 2° standard-observer tables already included
in `Argyll_V3.5.0`. The generator linearly interpolates the 5 nm illuminant data
onto the observer's 1 nm grid from 360 through 780 nm. IwashiScope uses this
table to integrate the measured reflectance spectrum directly; the displayed
Lab value is not an input to the Munsell calculation.
